title: Baa Juice Watermelon Mojito Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Watermelon Mojito Shortfill brings a cocktail-inspired blend to your vape. Juicy Watermelon sets a sweet base, zesty Lime adds tangy brightness, and a dash of cool Mint rounds the mix with a refreshing lift. Together they recreate the taste of a Mojito with a fruity twist. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills are made with double-concentrated flavouring, ensuring every puff delivers full and lasting taste.
